description:
The RRCGDB scheme stands for the Rajiv Gandhi Chikitsa Yojana. 

It was launched by the Government of Rajasthan. 

The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for medical treatment to the economically weaker sections of society. 

The objective is to ensure that individuals from low-income families can access necessary healthcare services without financial burden. 

The benefits include coverage for hospitalization expenses and surgeries. 

The scheme provides cashless treatment in empaneled hospitals. 

Eligibility is limited to residents of Rajasthan who belong to below poverty line families. 

The application process involves submitting a form along with required documents to the local government office or through designated online portals. 

The timeline for processing applications may vary but is generally expedited to ensure timely medical assistance. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Medical and Health, Government of Rajasthan. 

Additional details about specific coverage limits and empaneled hospitals can be obtained from official government sources.
